title: House of Adanna - Videos
description:
A global lifestyle community that empowers women, by Dr Adanna.

Dr Adanna Steinacker is a medical doctor, entrepreneur, public speaker, digital influencer, and a strong advocate for women's empowerment. 

With a drive to achieve global impact, she transitioned from clinical medicine to entrepreneurship. Leveraging social media, and building an engaged community of nearly 1 million people combined, she now runs her purpose-driven brand 'House of Adanna', with a mission to empower women. Creating engaging content around the topics of health, well-being, sustainability, motherhood, entrepreneurship, and equality, including Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) #sdg5 & #sdg3. 

With extensive knowledge in multiple industries you will find Adanna sharing her experiences & adventures, or simply enjoying some family time with her husband and three kids.

We hope that you enjoy being part of this community 

For partnership enquiries - management@houseofadanna.com
